newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisian imports of vegetable oil 197,000 T in '96.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian imports of vegetable oil 197,000 T in '96.

text.p: Tunisia, a leading olive oil exporter, imported 197,000 tonnes of vegetable oils in 1996, up from 177,000 tonnes in 1995, official statistics showed on Friday.
Value of vegetable oils imports was 112.57 million dinars in 1996 compared to 111.01 million dinars in 1995.

Rise in imports of vegetable oils was linked to the drop of olive oil output during the last two years due to drought, traders said. Production of olive oil was 60,000 tonnes in 1996 and 70,000 tonnes in 1995. It is estimated at 250,000 tonnes in 1997.
Tunisia's average imports of vegetable oils was about 140,000 tonnes yearly during the last five years.
